name: Open a document
description: An illustrative Loom scenario, not live traffic.

steps.name: Open document
steps.description: You choose a document. Pages requests its saved content.

steps.name: Find saved content
steps.description: The gateway asks Records for the document model.

steps.name: Read document
steps.description: Records returns the saved document model to the gateway.

steps.name: Load into editor
steps.description: The gateway delivers the document model to Authoring in the web editor.

steps.name: Show document
steps.description: Authoring passes the loaded model to Rendering for display.
